note: All columns except IS are the original 1 Hz values. IS was replaced with the corrected definition (hourly resampling, Witting et al. 1990) computed from the 5-minute recordings. Corrected IS is independent of source resolution: 1 Hz and 5-minute agree to 3e-06 (0.001%), verified on 6 participants. IV is unchanged and remains 1 Hz, so it is not comparable with 5-minute IV.
